visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium shot of the exterior of a bento shop named '豐閣家開伙'. It has a clean white facade with a wooden door and a small light fixture. A hand enters the frame holding two red bento boxes filled with various meats and vegetables. (2) The scene transitions to a top-down view where a hand lifts the upper tray of a bento box to reveal white rice mixed with red quinoa. Close-up shots follow, showing red chopsticks picking up tender, glazed slices of beef. (3) In the kitchen, a male chef wearing an orange shirt, a white cap, and a black mask is seen stir-frying beef in a pan over a gas stove. The lighting is bright and industrial. (4) Multiple macro close-ups showcase the food: a crispy golden-brown fried pork cutlet is sliced, and a rich, red mapo tofu sauce is scooped into a cup and then drizzled over the rice and meat. (5) Additional bento varieties are presented, including salted grilled pork belly and beef topped with melted cheese slices. The final shots show a bowl of miso soup and the restaurant's interior view through a large window, followed by an ending title card with contact details.
